title: Business Central 2025 wave 1 (BC26.2): Add fields/columns from related tables in analysis mode (No customization)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 1 (BC26.2) introduces the ability to add fields from related tables directly in analysis mode without customization, enabling more advanced data analysis and grouping capabilities across table relationships.
key_points: Users can add fields from related tables to analysis mode tabs via context menu options
Available fields must already exist on pages; the dialog shows the source table and fields
Multiple fields can be selected at once; added related fields can be removed using the Remove related columns action
Filtering, sorting, and pivoting on calculated fields is limited for performance; Excel exports show only visible data
This feature builds on analysis mode capabilities introduced in BC22 and enhanced through subsequent releases
features: Analysis mode with related table fields

quotes.text: Analysis mode is a powerful experience that lets you create and analyze data views easily.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core value of the feature for end users creating custom data views
